result.rationale: The rescue team is being progressively worn down by spatial/hostile pressure before any rescue affordance becomes actionable. Engineer Imani drops from 100→71→46→36→26→16 health across turns 1-5, repeatedly taking scatter-blast damage from Raider Holt (29, 25) and reactor-instability environmental damage (10/turn) while moving through the reactor corridor. Security Chen also bleeds health (110→100→90→80→55→45) from reactor environment and Raider Holt. Meanwhile the rescue objective stays at 0/2: civilian-kade at life-console is never reached (Imani keeps being routed through reactor instead), and medic-reyes escorts civilian-sato but is repeatedly contested on zone capacity (turn 4 medic-reyes contested target_zone_capacity_lost moving to junction-cover). The reactor-heat climbs 62→70→78→86→94→100, crossing the threshold at turn 4, and the team is pinned in the reactor area taking environmental damage each turn. The core blocker is that hostile spatial pressure (Raider Holt's scatter-blast reach, reactor-instability hazard, zone capacity contestation) prevents the actors from reaching and executing the rescue affordance before health is drained. This is a survival-spatial-pressure bottleneck rather than an information or policy problem: the routes and contacts are known (civilian-kade and civilian-sato both located), but the team cannot survive the spatial gauntlet to act on them.
